d.ko: Surgeon Simulator is an over-the-top operation sim, stitching together pitch-black humour with life-saving surgery. Become Dr. Burke, a would-be surgeon with a less than conventional toolkit, as he performs procedures on patients including the Heavy from TF2! ...is that a hammer?

d.zh: Surgeon Simulator 是一款超级夸张的手术模拟器，将黑到骨子里的幽默和治病救人的手术缝合在了一起！作为布鲁克医生——一位自称是外科医生而且装备简陋的人，对他的病人实行外科手术，其中就包括唐纳德·特朗普！……这应该是锤子吧？
